scope: Proposition 3.6 of the manuscript “Donovan's Conjecture over Algebraically Closed Fields” (preprints/Donovans-Conjecture-over-Algebraic-Closures-of-Prime-Fields-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 203 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 18. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a constant L, depending only on the fixed root data, such that for every (x, ϕ) there is an object Tx,ϕ with both a standard and a costandard flag. A specified standard flag has length at most L, contains ∆x,ϕ once, and has all remaining factors on strictly smaller Bruhat strata. Thus the standard multiplicity matrix is triangular, with identity diagonal blocks.
